runtimeContracts: Actual dedicated WASM worker full/warm Rust, HTML and Markdown results match the typed cooperative adapter after source resynchronization
All supported language core contracts compare framed and typed full/warm payloads and run the shared source-bound proof
Framed publication retains source-budget accounting and installs a delta base only after complete encoding
Cancellation takes priority over an expired work budget and never installs a partial delta base
Oversized and reordered frames and invalid control transaction parts fail transport validation
Dropped request futures release their pending transaction without exposing an incomplete reply
Existing local/remote coalescing, stale owner, fallback, dense-row and embedded-language contracts remain unchanged
build: Current release WASM library and component bundles generated after the final source edits
limitations: No end-to-end production latency or memory improvement is established
Vector/string capacity growth and per-row immutable allocation/copying remain synchronous
JavaScript string conversion and external parser/request snapshots remain on the roadmap
Storage, projection, diff, history and recovery costs and final integrated completion gates remain unfinished
Latest checkpoint still requires hosted integrated CI; physical Chrome/Edge PWA/device checks remain required
